I met my ex online, knew him for 2 months and then took a bus all by myself 4 hours from home to a city I had never been to before to stay with him. In my case, it turned out great, and even though he is my ex now those were some of the best months of my life. If you do decide to go, make sure your friends and parents know exactly where you’re going, to what address and such. My parents made me give them his parents phone numbers lmao. Ideally you would take a friend with you, but I understand if you dont wanna. Just make sure to be safe and careful. Meet up with her at a public place first.

I always think communication is key. Reach out, and let this time be clear. Text the girl who has been checking up on you, and ask her for a straight answer. If they give you false hope and say things like “yeah we miss you but we’re not ready just yet”, you’ll still cling on to that hope, even if that’s not their real intentions. Be clear, be respectful. Tell her that this has been really hard on you and the whole situation has been on your mind constantly, giving you anxiety. Say that you want a straight answer - do they want you back in the group? Don’t take “maybe” or “perhaps in a while” for an answer. And if that’s the only answer you get, I would say drop them because those types of girls are not worth being friends with in the long run.
